rationale: DEV split only (held-out is consumed and never re-run). With the fake embedder and the fixed UUID layout the run is deterministic, so any change is a real behaviour change. A drop counts as material when it exceeds one query's worth on 24 queries (1/24 = 0.0417), e.g. one query losing its only relevant document from the top 5 or its first-rank hit. Smaller drops are reported, not gated. Improvements never fail; refresh this baseline deliberately in the same commit as the change.
